appTagline: Local-first screen time tracking for Windows
appDescription: Understand where your time goes. Hora tracks active applications and browsing domains locally, never sends data to a server, and helps you build healthier digital habits.
dashboardSubtitle: Active screen time measured locally on this device.
dashboardEmpty: No activity recorded yet. Hora starts counting as soon as you use your PC.
dashboardEmptyHint: Keep Hora running in the tray for accurate results.
dashboardPrivacy: Privacy mode hides window titles for password managers and banking sites.
dashboardTrackingNote: Hora samples the foreground window every second and stores only durations.
historySubtitle: Daily totals for the last seven days.
settingsSubtitle: Personalize Hora, control behavior, and manage your data.
settingsThemeHelp: Choose a palette. The accent color is applied across the whole app.
settingsThemeCustomHelp: Enter a hexadecimal color such as 7C8CF8.
settingsThemeInvalid: Enter a valid hexadecimal color, for example 7C8CF8.
settingsZoomHelp: Scales text and controls from 80 to 150 percent.
settingsFontScaleHelp: Additional text scaling for better readability.
settingsLanguageHelp: The interface changes instantly. Windows language is used on first start.
settingsStartWithWindowsHelp: Launch Hora automatically when you sign in.
settingsSilentStartHelp: Keep Hora running in the tray without opening a window.
settingsHotkeyHelp: Show or hide Hora from anywhere. Example: Ctrl+Alt+H.
settingsHotkeyInvalid: This shortcut could not be registered. Try another combination.
settingsJumpListHelp: Adds quick actions to the taskbar right-click menu.
settingsTrayIconHelp: The selected icon applies to the window, taskbar, tray, and desktop shortcut.
settingsNotificationsHelp: Show a notification when tracking starts, syncs, or updates.
settingsSoundHelp: Play a short sound with notifications.
settingsUpdatesLatest: You are running the latest version.
settingsUpdatesError: Could not reach the update service. Try again later.
settingsUpdatesReady: The installer has started. Hora will close.
settingsResetHelp: Restores defaults without deleting usage data.
settingsResetConfirm: Reset every setting to its default value?
backupSubtitle: Keep a portable copy of your settings and usage data in a cloud folder, without an account or a server.
backupProviderHelp: Hora writes to a folder that your cloud client already syncs. No OAuth and no subscription is required.
backupAutoSyncHelp: Saves settings and profiles shortly after each change, and once more when Hora closes.
backupFolderFallback: OneDrive was not found. Hora uses a safe local folder instead.
backupSyncFailed: Backup could not be completed. Your data is safe on this device.
backupRestoreConfirm: Restore the backup from {0}? Current settings will be replaced.
backupRestoreFailed: The backup could not be restored. A previous copy was kept.
backupDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect this backup folder? Existing files stay untouched.
backupRecoveryBody: A valid Hora backup was found in {0}. Restore it now or start fresh.
backupProtected: Empty data is never written over a valid backup.
diagnosticsSubtitle: Inspect the environment, run health checks, and prepare a support report.
diagnosticsRedact: Personal paths are shortened in copied reports.
docsSubtitle: Everything you need to get the most out of Hora.
docsGettingStartedBody: Hora starts with Windows and lives in the tray. Open the dashboard to see today's total, switch layouts, and pause tracking when you need privacy.
docsTrackingBody: Hora samples the active window every second and stores the application name, an optional browsing domain, and the duration. Idle time, locked sessions, and meetings are handled separately.
docsBackupBody: Choose OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, or any folder. Hora keeps the current snapshot, the previous snapshot, and fifteen daily backups, and it never overwrites a good backup with empty data.
docsPrivacyBody: No telemetry, no account, no cloud server. All measurements stay on this device unless you explicitly enable a backup folder.
docsSupportBody: Open Diagnostics to run health checks and copy a report. Logs are stored in the local data folder and never leave your PC automatically.
aboutSubtitle: A calm, local-first way to understand your screen time.
aboutBuiltWith: Built with .NET, WPF, and SQLite. No analytics, no tracking pixels, no accounts.
aboutCreditsBody: Design and engineering by Vellium. Icons and illustrations are original works.
legalPrivacyBody: Hora collects application usage durations and optional browsing domains on your device. Data is written to a local SQLite database and is never transmitted automatically. Backup files are created only in a folder you choose. You can delete all data at any time from Settings or by removing the application data folder.
legalTermsBody: Hora is provided as is, without warranty of any kind. You are responsible for how you use the measurements and for complying with local law and workplace policies. Do not use Hora to monitor other people without their consent.
legalLicenseBody: Hora is proprietary software owned by Vellium. Use is permitted only under a written commercial or pilot agreement with Vellium. Copying, modifying, redistributing, or selling the software is not allowed without written permission. The software is provided as is, without warranty of any kind.
wizardLanguageBody: Hora speaks 73 languages. You can change this later in Settings.
wizardThemeBody: Choose light, dark, or follow Windows. Every palette can be adjusted with a custom accent color.
wizardWelcomeBody: Hora quietly measures where your screen time goes, keeps everything on this PC, and helps you notice patterns without judgment.
wizardTourBody: The dashboard shows today's total and your top applications. The history page compares the last seven days. Settings covers themes, language, shortcuts, and privacy. Backup keeps a copy in your own cloud folder.
wizardPrivacyNote: No account. No telemetry. No cloud server.
trayHintBody: The window was hidden. Double-click the tray icon to open it again.

notifySyncBody: Your data was saved to the backup folder.
closeAskBody: Keep Hora running in the tray so tracking continues, or exit completely.
